Ignore all self-descriptions such as "у мене висока самеефективність", "я впевнений у собі".
Use only explicit linguistic patterns.
If indicators from different levels appear, always choose the lower score.

Score 0 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: external attribution or helplessness lexicon (semantic/cognitive marker; strong negative correlation) such as "я нічого не вирішую", "це не від мене залежить", "мене змушують"; vague or defeatist modals (syntactic/discourse marker) such as "навряд чи вийде", "не думаю, що зможу". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 0.

Score 1 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: general uncertainty markers (lexical/discourse marker) such as "не знаю", "можливо не впораюся"; passive constructions describing own actions (syntactic marker; avoidance pattern) such as "мене навчили", "було зроблено". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 1.

Score 2 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: low-confidence modals with self-reference (cognitive/discourse marker) such as "спробую, якщо пощастить", "може, якось вийде"; general statements about difficulty without plan (semantic marker) such as "це дуже складно", "не уявляю, як це зробити". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 2.

Score 3 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: neutral internal locus phrases without confidence (semantic marker) such as "буду щось робити", "намагатимуся сам"; presence of planning verbs without operational detail (discourse/cognitive marker) such as "планую почати", "хочу зробити". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 3.

Score 4 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: concrete first-person action verbs (lexical marker) such as "я розпочав", "я вирішив"; general positive agency statements (semantic marker) such as "я щось роблю сам", "справляюся поки що". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 4.

Score 5 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: explicit causal attribution to self (semantic/cognitive marker) such as "завдяки моїм діям", "я сам це зробив"; task-focused confidence verbs (lexical marker) such as "я впевнений, що зможу", "я знаю, як це вирішити". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 5.

Score 6 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: operational verbs indicating control over complex activity (semantic/cognitive marker) such as "керую процесом", "налагоджую", "оптимізую"; presence of internal performance standards (discourse marker) such as "я оцінюю результат", "я вимогливий до себе". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 6.

Score 7 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: multi-step procedural or strategic language (discourse/cognitive marker) such as "спочатку я аналізую, потім тестую", "я розбиваю задачу на етапи"; proactive future-oriented constructions (semantic marker) such as "я реалізую", "буду впроваджувати сам". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 7.

Score 8 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: self-regulatory lexicon (semantic/cognitive marker) such as "я контролюю свій підхід", "я адаптуюсь до змін"; resilience indicators under pressure (affective/discourse marker) such as "навіть у стресі зберігаю ефективність", "працюю зосереджено, коли важко". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 8.

Score 9 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: high-complexity mastery statements (semantic/pragmatic marker) such as "я володію всіма аспектами задачі", "знаю, як діяти у складних ситуаціях"; meta-cognitive self-optimization (cognitive marker) such as "я аналізую, як можу покращити", "вчуся з кожного досвіду". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 9.

Score 10 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: stable confidence combined with strategic generalization (semantic/discourse marker) such as "я знаю, як справлятись з новими викликами", "мені під силу швидко освоїти нове"; dominant self-as-agent control structure across text (syntactic/discourse marker) such as repeated active constructions "я роблю", "я впливаю", "я вирішую", with absence of passive or uncertain expressions. Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 10.

When in doubt, always choose the lower score.
Output only one number.

scales.name: Стійкість
scales.instructions:
Шкала Стійкості (Resilience) — Psychological Capital (PsyCap).Resilience (PsyCap Model) Scale.
Score must be a single number from 0 to 10.
Evaluate only linguistic indicators showing recovery, adaptability, stress tolerance, positive reappraisal, persistence, emotional regulation, and learning from failure expressed in text.
Ignore all self-descriptions such as "я дуже стійкий", "я завжди справляюся з труднощами".
Use only explicit linguistic patterns (detectable tokens/phrases); treat Ukrainian examples as patterns and also accept their clear Russian equivalents.
Cumulative rule: to assign score N, you must satisfy the Required condition for every score from 0 through N.
If indicators from different levels appear, always choose the lower score.

Score 0 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: fatalistic resignation lexicon (semantic marker; strong negative correlation) such as "все марно", "нічого не зміниться", "я здався"; rumination-without-action pattern (discourse + lexical; negative correlation) such as "постійно думаю про це", "знову й знову переживаю". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 0.

Score 1 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: globalizing negative generalizations (cognitive-affective marker; negative correlation) such as "зі мною завжди так", "ніколи не вдається"; absence of any action verbs related to coping or adaptation. Required: 1 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 1.

Score 2 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: expression of emotional overwhelm without recovery move (affective-pragmatic marker; negative correlation) such as "мене накрило", "я не витримую"; syntactic repetition of negative state without narrative progress (discourse marker) such as "було важко, потім ще гірше", "і ще, і ще". Required: 1 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 2.

Score 3 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: minimal acknowledgment of difficulty with neutral stance (lexical/discourse marker; weak positive correlation) such as "так, це було непросто", "ситуація була складна"; absence of catastrophizing metaphors (e.g. "все розвалилось", "повна руїна"). Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 3.

Score 4 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: explicit recovery verbs without elaboration (lexical marker; positive correlation) such as "відновився", "зібрався", "пережив"; single instance of temporal persistence marker (e.g. "не здався", "тримався"). Required: 1 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 4.

Score 5 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: explicit adaptation/change verbs (semantic-cognitive marker; positive correlation) such as "пристосувався", "змінив підхід", "відкоригував план"; presence of reframing phrase (cognitive marker; moderate correlation) such as "це дало мені урок", "я виніс щось корисне". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 5.

Score 6 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: presence of emotion regulation act (affective-pragmatic marker; positive correlation) such as "заспокоївся", "перефокусувався", "перевів подих"; past-tense narrative with functional outcome (discourse + tense marker) such as "після цього я почав діяти", "і з того моменту стало краще". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 6.

Score 7 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: learning-from-failure marker (cognitive-pragmatic marker; strong positive correlation) such as "зробив висновки", "усвідомив помилки", "тепер знаю, що робити"; persistence-under-adversity phrasing (lexical-discourse marker) such as "не опустив рук", "працював, хоч і було важко". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 7.

Score 8 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: explicit reappraisal construction (cognitive marker; strong positive correlation) such as "спочатку це виглядало як поразка, але…", "втрата обернулася можливістю"; discourse structure with crisis → coping → growth sequence (narrative structure marker) such as "спочатку було важко, потім я зробив…, тепер…". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 8.

Score 9 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: collective coping or team-based resilience phrasing (social-discourse marker; strong correlation) such as "разом із командою пройшли через", "ми адаптувались"; stable value/identity anchoring (semantic-cognitive marker) such as "залишився вірним своїм принципам", "мої цінності не змінилися". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 9.

Score 10 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: multi-layered narrative of adversity with explicit transformation (complex discourse-cognitive marker) such as "це мене змінило", "я став сильнішим"; full integration of experience with future orientation and control (semantic + future-tense + causation marker) such as "тепер я знаю, як діяти в подібних ситуаціях", "завдяки цьому я підготований до викликів". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 10.

When in doubt, always choose the lower score.
Output only one number.

scales.name: Оптимізм
scales.instructions:
Шкала Оптимізму (Optimism) — Psychological Capital (PsyCap).[PsyCap Optimism] Scale.
Score must be a single number from 0 to 10.  
Evaluate only linguistic indicators showing realistic future-oriented positive outcome expectancies, adaptive explanatory style, and constructive framing under uncertainty.  
Ignore all self-descriptions such as "я оптиміст", "у мене позитивне мислення".  
Use only explicit linguistic patterns.  
If indicators from different levels appear, always choose the lower score.  

Score 0 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: global-negative explanatory absolutisms (semantic marker; strong negative correlation) such as "все погано", "ніколи не вийде", "усе зруйнується"; future-negation framing (semantic/syntactic marker) such as "нема майбутнього", "нічого доброго не буде". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 0.

Score 1 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: temporally stable and uncontrollable attribution of failure (cognitive/explanatory marker) such as "так завжди", "це ніколи не зміниться", "нічого не залежить від мене"; lexical fatalism markers (semantic/affective) such as "доля така", "так треба", "карма". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present.  

Score 2 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: pessimistic forecasting modal constructions (lexico-syntactic marker) such as "швидше за все буде погано", "навряд чи щось зміниться"; lack of agency verbs in future frame (pragmatic marker; negative) such as no first-person planning verbs (e.g. "зроблю", "спробую") in future-oriented segments. Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present.  

Score 3 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: problem-centric framing without solution orientation (discourse marker; negative correlation) such as "проблем багато", "все складно", "не знаю, як далі"; negative future markers dominating positive ones (frequency index ratio < 0.5); absence of conditional positive scenarios. Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present.  

Score 4 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: hedged or tentative positive framing (lexico-pragmatic marker; weakly positive) such as "можливо, щось вийде", "сподіваюсь, хоч трохи покращиться"; specific-attribution for failure (positive explanatory style) such as "цього разу було важко", "у цій ситуації не склалось". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present.  

Score 5 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: balanced modal forecasting with realistic constraints (syntactic/semantic marker; positive correlation) such as "можемо досягти, якщо буде план", "ймовірно покращиться, якщо зробимо X"; presence of temporal containment for negative events such as "це тимчасово", "цей етап пройде". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present.  

Score 6 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: conditional constructive prediction (syntactic/cognitive marker) such as "якщо будемо працювати, буде результат", "за умови дій – буде прогрес"; presence of internal controllable attribution for potential success such as "бо я навчився", "бо ми підготувалися". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present.  

Score 7 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: proactive future-oriented planning (semantic/syntactic marker) such as "зробимо крок за кроком", "я планую наступне"; inclusion of positive outcome verbs in future tense (lexical marker) such as "отримаємо", "зможемо", "просунемось". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present.  

Score 8 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: explicit mention of potential for growth/opportunity under uncertainty (semantic/cognitive marker) such as "це шанс для зростання", "можна використати ситуацію"; anti-catastrophizing phrase (affective/cognitive marker) such as "не так страшно, як здається", "все складно, але керовано". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present.  

Score 9 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: sustained positive explanatory style for past and future (discourse marker) such as "раніше виходило, отже і тепер вийде", "ми вже бачили прогрес"; realistic expectation of improvement supported by data/action (pragmatic/cognitive) such as "є план, тому логічно чекати покращення", "враховуючи результати, все йде добре". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present.  

Score 10 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: stable internal attribution for prior success AND conditional forecast for scalable positive future (combined explanatory + future framing marker) such as "ми досягли цього, бо правильно діяли — і зможемо ще", "ми виросли завдяки системі, тож тепер маємо всі шанси"; absence of naive magical optimism markers (disqualifier: "якось саме вирішиться", "все буде добре просто так"). Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present.  

When in doubt, always choose the lower score.  
Output only one number.

scales.name: Агентність
scales.instructions:
Шкала Агентності (Agency) — Interpersonal Circumplex (IPC).AGENCY (Interpersonal Dominance) Scale.
Score must be a single integer number from 0 to 10.
Evaluate only linguistic indicators showing high or low interpersonal dominance, assertiveness, and agentive control expressed in text.
Ignore all self-descriptions such as "я лідер", "я доміную в команді".
Use only explicit linguistic patterns (detectable tokens/phrases); treat Ukrainian examples as patterns and also accept their clear Russian equivalents.
Cumulative rule: to assign score N, you must satisfy the Required condition for every score from 0 through N.
If indicators from different levels appear, always choose the lower score.

Score 0 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: passive voice (syntactic marker; negative correlation with AGENCY) such as "мене направили", "було вирішено"; submission lexicon (semantic marker; negative correlation) such as "мені сказали", "я пішов за вказівкою". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 0.

Score 1 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: hedging modal verbs or uncertainty lexicon (lexical marker; negative correlation) such as "можливо", "мабуть", "не знаю точно"; presence of third-person external agency attribution (semantic marker; negative) such as "вони вирішили", "керівництво сказало". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 1.

Score 2 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: lack of self-reference in agentive subject position (syntactic/lexical marker; negative) such as predominant use of impersonal forms; response-only interactional framing (discourse marker) such as "коли мене запитали", "мене викликали на розмову". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 2.

Score 3 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: low-confidence directive forms (pragmatic marker; weak agency) such as "може варто було б", "я б запропонував"; low-strength assertive verbs (lexical marker) such as "спробував", "попросив", "висловив думку". Required: 1 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 3.

Score 4 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: first-person subject-verb-object construction without directive or influence verbs (syntactic/semantic marker) such as "я зробив звіт", "я пішов на зустріч"; minimal proactivity lexicon (semantic marker) such as "я виконав", "я підготував". Required: 1 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 4.

Score 5 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: explicit responsibility-taking lexicon (semantic marker; moderate agency) such as "я взяв на себе", "це була моя зона"; neutral directive phrasing without coercion (pragmatic marker) such as "я запропонував зробити", "я ініціював обговорення". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 5.

Score 6 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: directive verbs with moderate force (lexical marker) such as "я вирішив", "я організував", "я направив"; assertive sentence structures (syntactic marker; no hedging, no passivization) such as "я ініціював", "ми задали тон". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 6.

Score 7 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: interpersonal control lexicon (semantic/pragmatic marker) such as "я керую процесом", "я відповідаю за напрям"; topic-setting discourse structures (discourse marker) such as "давайте почнемо з", "спочатку розглянемо". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 7.

Score 8 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: influence/persuasion lexicon in assertive framing (semantic marker) such as "я переконав команду", "я навів аргументи і ми змінили підхід"; dominant framing of action path (cognitive/discourse marker) such as "я вирішив, як ми будемо діяти", "я визначив хід роботи". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 8.

Score 9 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: leadership-status lexicon with explicit claim (semantic marker) such as "я очолюю команду", "я — керівник напряму"; multi-level directive/coordination verbs (lexical marker) such as "я координую", "я керую", "я спрямовую інших". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 9.

Score 10 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: high-potency control and impact language across multiple sentence types (semantic/pragmatic marker) such as "я контролюю процес повністю", "всі рішення — на мені"; discourse dominance indicators: speaker directs interaction, closes topics, redefines others’ statements (discourse/pragmatic marker) such as "давайте не про це, повернемося до головного", "так, але правильно буде так". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 10.

When in doubt, always choose the lower score.
Output only one number.

scales.name: Комунальність
scales.instructions:
Шкала Комунальності (Communion) — Interpersonal Circumplex (IPC).\Communion/Warmth Scale.
Score must be a single number from 0 to 10.
Evaluate only linguistic indicators showing warmth, friendliness, affiliation, empathy, inclusiveness, and supportive/cooperative interpersonal orientation expressed in text.
Ignore all self-descriptions such as "я теплий/доброзичливий", "я дуже емпатичний", "у мене високий рівень комунальності".
Use only explicit linguistic patterns; treat Ukrainian examples as patterns and also accept their clear Russian equivalents.
If indicators from different levels appear, always choose the lower score.

Score 0 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: explicit hostile/abusive lexicon (strong negative marker) such as "дурний", "нікчемний", "ідіот", "мені начхати", лайка/образи; “you-attack / you-blame” обвинувальні конструкції з абсолютами (pragmatic marker of конфронтації) such as "ти завжди…", "ти ніколи…", "ти знову все зіпсував". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 0.

Score 1 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: знецінювальна/байдужа відмова від зв’язку (semantic-pragmatic marker) such as "мені все одно", "мені начхати", "розбирайся сам"; прямі наказові імперативи без пом’якшень (style marker of cold control) such as "зроби негайно", "припини", "замовкни", "роби як сказано" (без "будь ласка"/умовного способу). Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 1.

Score 2 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: безособово-канцелярські/пасивні конструкції з мінімумом адресності (style marker of aloofness) such as "зроблено", "підготовлено", "пропозиції прийнято до уваги", "виконати у встановлений термін"; відсутність будь-яких явних маркерів теплоти/афіліації (lexical absence marker) meaning no tokens from gratitude/support/greeting set such as "дякую", "вдячний", "радий", "приємно", "будь ласка", "перепрошую", "підтримую", "допоможу". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 2.

Score 3 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: виражений егоцентричний фокус (pronoun-ratio marker) such as часті "я/мені/мій" при майже нульових "ми/наш/нам" у всьому фрагменті; конфронтаційно-змагальна семантика (semantic marker) such as "виграти спір", "довести", "перемогти", "я правий", "сильні перемагають слабких", "мене не цікавить компроміс". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 3.

Score 4 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: наявність мінімум одного етикетного маркера ввічливості (politeness token) such as "будь ласка", "дякую", "перепрошую", "добрий день/привіт"; наявність мінімум одного нейтрального залучення співрозмовника без емпатії (interactive but not warm) such as "як ти думаєш?", "яка твоя думка?", "чи є питання?" (без фраз типу "розумію тебе/мені шкода"). Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 4.

Score 5 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: інклюзивні/кооперативні маркери “ми-наративу” (we-talk marker) such as "ми", "наш", "нам", "разом", "спільно"; узгоджувальні/компромісні дискурсивні маркери (cooperation marker) such as "давай домовимося", "знайдемо варіант, який підійде всім", "спільне рішення", "дійти згоди". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 5.

Score 6 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: явна пропозиція допомоги/підтримки (affiliative action verbs) such as "допоможу", "підтримую", "подбаю", "я поруч", "можу підхопити"; явні маркери ввічливості у формі прохання/пропозиції (politeness strategy) such as "будь ласка, чи не міг/могла б…", "мені б хотілося запропонувати…", "дякую за…". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 6.

Score 7 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: валідація/активне слухання (supportive response marker) such as "розумію, що це для тебе важливо", "правильно я почув, тобі…", "я бачу, що тобі неприємно/боляче"; face-saving / пом’якшення незгоди або критики (pragmatic marker) such as "розумію твою точку зору, хоча не погоджуся", "не хочу образити, але…", "можливо, варто спробувати інакше?". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 7.

Score 8 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: емпатійне врахування перспективи іншого (perspective-taking marker) such as "тобі, мабуть, важко", "ти засмутився/засмутилася", "мені важливо, що ти думаєш/відчуваєш", "мені шкода, що…"; лексика довіри/відкритості (trust marker) such as "довіряю", "можна покластися", "щиро", "вірю, що ми впораємося", "я з тобою". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 8.

Score 9 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: явне пріоритетизування гармонії/стосунків над “перемогою” (value marker) such as "для мене важливі стосунки/повага", "хочу зберегти добрі взаємини", "важливо, щоб нам обом було ок"; стійкий “ми-наратив” у всьому тексті (discourse consistency marker) meaning щонайменше 3 окремі клаузы/речення з “ми/нам/наш” у контексті спільних рішень/дій such as "ми вирішили…", "нам вдалося…", "ми зробимо…". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 9.

Score 10 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: явний repair-патерн у конфлікті (relationship-repair marker) such as "вибач/перепрошую, я був неправий/неправою" + "давай разом виправимо/знайдемо рішення/перезапустимо розмову" (в одному фрагменті тексту); узагальнена міжконтекстна сталість теплоти (cross-domain consistency marker) such as "як у роботі, так і в житті мені важливо підтримувати людей", "в усіх сферах я стараюся бути уважним/уважною до почуттів інших", "мені важливо, щоб поруч зі мною людям було безпечно". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 10.

When in doubt, always choose the lower score.
Output only one number.

scales.name: Фокус просування
scales.instructions:
Шкала Фокусу Просування (Promotion Focus) — Regulatory Focus Theory.Promotion Focus (Regulatory Focus Theory, Higgins) Linguistic Scale.
Score must be a single number from 0 to 10.
Evaluate only linguistic indicators showing Promotion Focus: explicit orientation toward gains/rewards, opportunities, ideals/aspirations, advancement/growth, and eager approach (ініціація, швидкість, експеримент) in text.
Ignore all self-descriptions such as "я амбітний", "я оптиміст", "у мене промо-фокус", "я про розвиток", "у мене BAS", "я дуже мотивований".
Use only explicit linguistic patterns that are countable/detectable in text.
If indicators from different levels appear, always choose the lower score.
When in doubt, always choose the lower score.
Output only one number.

Score 0 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: aspiration/ideal verb pattern (positive correlation with Promotion Focus; RFT ideals/aspirations) such as "хочу запустити проєкт", "мрію стати експертом"; explicit goal/target noun (positive correlation; goal talk) such as "моя мета — …", "ціль на цей місяць — …"; future-oriented projection (LIWC Time: Future focus; positive correlation) such as "буде результат", "стане так, як я хочу", "я зроблю це". Required: 3 of 3 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 0.

Score 1 is assigned only if all indicators required for Score 0 are present and all of the following additional linguistic indicators appear: achievement/reward lexicon (LIWC Drives: Achievement and/or Reward; positive correlation) such as "успіх", "досягнення", "перемога", "виграш", "бонус", "визнання", "результат". Required: 1 of 1 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 1.

Score 2 is assigned only if all indicators required for Score 1 are present and all of the following additional linguistic indicators appear: opportunity lexicon (positive correlation; sensitivity to opportunities/rewards) such as "можливість", "шанс", "перспектива", "потенціал", "вікно можливостей". Required: 1 of 1 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 2.

Score 3 is assigned only if all indicators required for Score 2 are present and all of the following additional linguistic indicators appear: advancement/growth action verbs (positive correlation; RFT advancement/growth) such as "запустити", "розширити", "масштабувати", "побудувати", "збільшити", "вирости", "прокачати". Required: 1 of 1 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 3.

Score 4 is assigned only if all indicators required for Score 3 are present and all of the following additional linguistic indicators appear: explicit gain-framing link between action and gain (positive correlation; gain framing) such as "якщо зробимо X, отримаємо Y", "це дасть приріст", "це принесе результат/вигоду", "запустимо — і отримаємо більше клієнтів". Required: 1 of 1 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 4.

Score 5 is assigned only if all indicators required for Score 4 are present and all of the following additional linguistic indicators appear: initiative/proposal speech act (positive correlation; pragmatics of initiation/eagerness) such as "давай зробимо…", "пропоную запустити…", "пішли протестимо…", "я запускаю це", "беру на себе реліз". Required: 1 of 1 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 5.

Score 6 is assigned only if all indicators required for Score 5 are present and all of the following additional linguistic indicators appear: eagerness/urgency speed marker tied to action (positive correlation; eager strategy) such as "якнайшвидше запускаємо", "вже сьогодні стартуємо", "зараз беремося", "не гаяти часу", "важливо не проґавити шанс". Required: 1 of 1 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 6.

Score 7 is assigned only if all indicators required for Score 6 are present and all of the following additional linguistic indicators appear: exploration/experiment/innovation lexicon (positive correlation; opportunity pursuit/exploration) such as "експеримент", "протестимо", "спробуємо новий підхід", "інновація", "нетипове рішення", "пілот/пілотний запуск". Required: 1 of 1 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 7.

Score 8 is assigned only if all indicators required for Score 7 are present and all of the following additional linguistic indicators appear: high-arousal positive affect explicitly tied to goal/opportunity/action (LIWC Affective: Positive Emotion; positive correlation) such as "мене драйвить ця можливість", "я в захваті від ідеї запустити це", "це реально надихає", "є азарт це зробити". Required: 1 of 1 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 8.

Score 9 is assigned only if all indicators required for Score 8 are present and all of the following additional linguistic indicators appear: abstract/global outcome language (LCM-style interpretive/state/quality framing; positive correlation) such as "покращити ситуацію", "посилити позицію", "зробити процес ефективнішим", "стати сильнішими/кращими", "вивести на інший рівень якості". Required: 1 of 1 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 9.

Score 10 is assigned only if all indicators required for Score 9 are present and all of the following additional linguistic indicators appear: gain-dominance density (positive correlation) with at least two distinct gain-framing sentences such as "це дасть приріст", "отримаємо результат/виграш", "принесе бонус/визнання" and zero explicit loss-avoidance sentences such as "щоб не втратити", "аби уникнути", "не допустити провалу"; zero duty/obligation lexicon occurrences (negative correlation with Promotion Focus; prevention confound) such as "повинен", "маю (як обов’язок)", "зобов’язаний"; zero anxiety/anger lexicon occurrences (LIWC Affective: Anxiety and Anger; negative correlation relative to promotion profile) such as "боюся", "страшно", "тривожно", "злюся", "бісить"; explicit progress-arc or “new level” narrative tied to advancement (positive correlation; discourse of growth/progress) such as "за рік виросли", "від малого до великого", "перейшли на новий рівень", "поступово наростили результат". Required: 4 of 4 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 10.

When in doubt, always choose the lower score.
Output only one number.

scales.name: Фокус запобігання
scales.instructions:
Шкала Фокусу Запобігання (Prevention Focus) — Regulatory Focus Theory.Prevention Focus (Regulatory Focus Theory) Linguistic Scale.
Score must be a single number from 0 to 10.
Evaluate only linguistic indicators showing Prevention Focus in text: duty/ought orientation, compliance with rules, loss-avoidance/safety seeking, vigilance/error-avoidance, and sanction sensitivity (fear of punishment/criticism).
Ignore all self-descriptions such as "я обережний", "я перестрахувальник", "я тривожний", "у мене високий prevention focus", "я дуже відповідальний".
Use only explicit linguistic patterns in the text (wording, constructions, questions, framing).
If indicators from different levels appear, always choose the lower score.
To assign the score, test criteria from 10 down to 0; if any required indicator for a score is missing, move to the next lower score; if no score criteria are satisfied, output 0.

Score 0 is assigned only if at least one of the following linguistic indicators appears: weak avoidance framing with negation (positive/increases Prevention Focus) using explicit patterns like "щоб не + дієслово/інфінітив" or "не + допустити/забути/запізнитись" such as "Вийду раніше, щоб не запізнитись", "Поставлю нагадування, щоб не забути"; LIWC Tentative-style hedging (positive/increases Prevention Focus) with explicit hedges such as "можливо", "мабуть", "напевно", "здається", "не певен" such as "Можливо, краще почекати", "Не певен, чи це добра ідея"; mild caution/safe-avoid comparison (positive/increases Prevention Focus) using explicit cues like "обережно" or "краще X, ніж Y" such as "Обережно, тут слизько", "Краще почекати, ніж поспішити". Required: 1 of 3 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 0.

Score 1 is assigned only if all required indicators for score 0 are present and the following additional linguistic indicator appears: deontic obligation modality (positive/increases Prevention Focus; duty/ought) with explicit modals such as "треба/потрібно/необхідно/слід/повинен/маю/зобов’язаний" (and equivalents "надо/нужно/необходимо/следует/должен/обязан") such as "Мені треба зробити це правильно", "Я повинен здати це вчасно". Required: 1 of 1 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 1.

Score 2 is assigned only if all required indicators for score 1 are present and the following additional linguistic indicator appears: preventive conditional constructions (positive/increases Prevention Focus; vigilance) with at least two explicit preventive patterns in the text, using cues such as "щоб не", "аби не", "на випадок (якщо)", "якщо раптом" (and equivalents "чтобы не", "на случай", "если вдруг") such as "Закрию вікно, щоб не продуло", "Візьму зарядку на випадок, якщо розрядиться". Required: 1 of 1 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 2.

Score 3 is assigned only if all required indicators for score 2 are present and the following additional linguistic indicator appears: risk/threat/loss/safety lexicon (positive/increases Prevention Focus; loss-avoidance) with at least two explicit tokens from risk/loss/safety domain such as "ризик/ризиковано", "небезпека", "загроза", "втрати/втратити", "безпека", "стабільність", "гарантія/гарантії" (and equivalents "риск", "опасность", "угроза", "потери", "безопасность", "стабильность", "гарантия") such as "Це занадто ризиковано", "Потрібні гарантії безпеки, щоб не було втрат". Required: 1 of 1 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 3.

Score 4 is assigned only if all required indicators for score 3 are present and all of the following additional linguistic indicators appear: checking/double-check verbs (positive/increases Prevention Focus; vigilance) with explicit verbs such as "перевірити/перевірю", "уточнити", "переконатися", "підстрахуватися" (and equivalents "проверить", "уточнить", "убедиться", "подстраховаться") such as "Дай я ще раз перевірю", "Хочу переконатися, що все правильно"; confirmation-seeking (positive/increases Prevention Focus; vigilance) with explicit request/question patterns such as "точно?", "правильно?", "перевір, будь ласка", "ти впевнений?" (and equivalents "точно?", "правильно?", "проверь, пожалуйста") such as "Точно так?", "Перевір, будь ласка, чи я нічого не пропустив". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 4.

Score 5 is assigned only if all required indicators for score 4 are present and all of the following additional linguistic indicators appear: rule/regulation/control lexicon (positive/increases Prevention Focus; duty/ought/compliance) with explicit tokens such as "правило/правила", "інструкція", "регламент", "процедура", "стандарт", "контроль", "порядок" (and equivalents "правила", "инструкция", "регламент", "процедура", "стандарт", "контроль", "порядок") such as "Діємо за інструкцією", "Це прописано в регламенті"; explicit prohibition/constraint modality (positive/increases Prevention Focus; duty/ought) with cues such as "не можна", "заборонено", "недопустимо", "не варто" (and equivalents "нельзя", "запрещено", "недопустимо", "не стоит") such as "Так робити не можна", "Відхилятися від процедури недопустимо". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 5.

Score 6 is assigned only if all required indicators for score 5 are present and all of the following additional linguistic indicators appear: error/failure lexicon (positive/increases Prevention Focus; error-avoidance) with explicit tokens such as "помилка/помилок", "провал", "прорахунок", "зіпсувати", "не допустити помилки" (and equivalents "ошибка", "провал", "промах") such as "Помилок бути не повинно", "Це буде провал"; punishment/sanction/criticism lexicon (positive/increases Prevention Focus; sanction sensitivity) with explicit tokens such as "штраф", "покарання", "санкції", "догана", "осуд", "претензії" (and equivalents "штраф", "наказание", "санкции", "выговор", "осуждение", "претензии") such as "За це буде штраф", "Щоб не отримати догану й претензії". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 6.

Score 7 is assigned only if all required indicators for score 6 are present and all of the following additional linguistic indicators appear: sanction-avoidance justification phrases (positive/increases Prevention Focus; regulatory fit via vigilant style) with explicit templates like "зробив(ла) X, щоб не було Y" where Y is social/organizational trouble, using cues such as "щоб не було проблем/питань/претензій/непорозумінь" such as "Зроблю це так, щоб не було питань", "Пишу детально, щоб не було претензій"; informal/colloquial sanction-avoidance cue (positive/increases Prevention Focus; sanction sensitivity) using explicit phrases like "щоб не прилетіло", "щоб потім не сварили/не чіплялись" such as "Все оформлю, щоб не прилетіло", "Роблю по формі, щоб потім не сварили". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 7.

Score 8 is assigned only if all required indicators for score 7 are present and all of the following additional linguistic indicators appear: LIWC Affective Anxiety / threat emotion words used to motivate prevention (positive/increases Prevention Focus) with explicit tokens such as "боюся", "хвилююся", "тривожно", "страшно", "нервую" (and equivalents "боюсь", "волнуюсь", "тревожно", "страшно", "нервничаю") such as "Хвилююся, щоб не зірвати дедлайн", "Боюся, що буде помилка"; multi-clause conditional chain (positive/increases Prevention Focus; vigilance/threat forecasting) with at least one sentence that explicitly combines condition + consequence + preventive purpose, using cues like "якщо/якщо раптом ... то ... щоб не ..." such as "Якщо щось піде не так, то я напишу заздалегідь, щоб не було непорозумінь", "Якщо раптом затримаюсь, то попереджу, щоб не було питань". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 8.

Score 9 is assigned only if all required indicators for score 8 are present and all of the following additional linguistic indicators appear: guilt/shame/self-blame lexicon in the context of duty/failure (positive/increases Prevention Focus; sanction sensitivity) with explicit tokens such as "винен/винна", "провина", "соромно", "сором" (and equivalents "виноват", "вина", "стыдно", "стыд") such as "Мені соромно, що підвів", "Я винен, що допустив помилку"; accountability/liable-agent focus (positive/increases Prevention Focus; sanction sensitivity) with explicit questions/statements about responsibility such as "хто відповідальний", "хто підписує", "з кого спитають", "хто винен" (and equivalents "кто ответственен", "кто подписывает", "с кого спросят", "кто виноват") such as "Хто відповідальний, якщо станеться збій?", "З кого спитають за цю помилку?". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 9.

Score 10 is assigned only if all required indicators for score 9 are present and all of the following additional linguistic indicators appear: explicit safe-choice preference that sacrifices gains to avoid losses (positive/increases Prevention Focus; loss-avoidance) using templates like "краще гарантовано менше, ніж ризикувати/втратити" or "обираю найбезпечніший/найнадійніший варіант" such as "Краще гарантовано менше, ніж ризикувати всім", "Я обираю найбезпечніший варіант, навіть якщо він менш вигідний"; explicit pre-mortem / “what can go wrong” framing (positive/increases Prevention Focus; vigilance) using cues like "що може піти не так", "найгірший сценарій" and at least one explicit negative scenario term in the same sentence (ризик/помилка/втрати/штраф) such as "Давай випишемо, що може піти не так, щоб не було помилок", "У найгіршому сценарії будуть втрати, тож треба перестрахуватися"; explicit backup/Plan B mention (positive/increases Prevention Focus; vigilance) with cues such as "план Б", "запасний варіант", "резерв", "резервний план", "підстраховка" such as "Тримаємо план Б на випадок збою", "Маємо запасний варіант, щоб не втратити час". Required: 3 of 3 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 10.

When in doubt, always choose the lower score.
Output only one number.

scales.name: Автономія
scales.instructions:
Шкала Автономії (Autonomy) — Self-Determination Theory (SDT).SDT Autonomy Linguistic Markers Scale.
Score must be a single number from 0 to 10.
Evaluate only linguistic indicators showing SDT-autonomy in text: autonomy satisfaction vs autonomy frustration, perceived choice/volition, internal perceived locus of causality (IPLOC) vs external pressure, self-endorsement/value congruence vs controlled/introjected regulation.
Ignore all self-descriptions such as "я автономний", "у мене висока автономія", "я дуже вмотивований", "я все контролюю".
Use only explicit linguistic patterns.
If indicators from different levels appear, always choose the lower score.

Score 0 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: deontic obligation lexicon with negative correlation to autonomy (at least 2 tokens) such as "мушу", "треба", "повинен", "маю"; explicit external force/pressure verbs with negative correlation to autonomy such as "мене змусили", "наказали", "від мене вимагають", "на мене тиснуть"; explicit no-choice phrases with negative correlation to autonomy such as "нема вибору", "не було вибору", "іншого виходу немає", "інакше не можна"; agent-removal via passive/impersonal constructions with negative correlation to autonomy such as "було вирішено", "прийнято рішення", "так склалося", "довелося зробити"; introjected guilt/shame lexicon with negative correlation to autonomy such as "мені соромно", "я винен", "провина", "не можна підвести", "треба бути хорошим"; negative affect/anger/helplessness lexicon (LIWC Negative Emotion/Anger/Sadness; negative correlation to autonomy satisfaction) such as "дратує", "злюсь", "образа", "безсилля", "опускаються руки". Required: 5 of 6 indicators must be present; If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 0.

Score 1 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: deontic obligation lexicon with negative correlation to autonomy (at least 2 tokens) such as "треба", "мушу", "повинен"; explicit motivational conflict/discrepancy (LIWC Discrepancy) with negative correlation to self-endorsement such as "не хочу, але треба", "хоч і не хочу, але мушу", "мені нецікаво, але потрібно"; explicit external causation phrases (external PLOC; negative correlation to autonomy) such as "бо мені сказали", "бо так наказали", "бо так прийнято", "бо від мене вимагають"; agent-removal via passive/impersonal constructions with negative correlation to autonomy such as "мене поставили перед фактом", "так вийшло", "потрібно зробити"; negative affect lexicon (LIWC Negative Emotion; negative correlation to autonomy satisfaction) such as "набридло", "важко", "виснажує". Required: 4 of 5 indicators must be present; If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 1.

Score 2 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: resignation/fate framing with negative correlation to perceived choice such as "довелося", "так склалося", "інакше не можна", "вийшло само"; agent-removal via impersonal necessity with negative correlation to autonomy such as "треба зробити", "потрібно виконати", "слід діяти"; explicit external causation (external PLOC; negative correlation) such as "бо так наказали", "бо так треба", "бо так прийнято"; deontic obligation lexicon with negative correlation to autonomy (at least 1 token) such as "треба", "повинен", "маю"; absence of explicit volition/choice verbs (0 tokens; negative correlation to autonomy satisfaction) from the set "хочу", "обираю", "вирішив", "мій вибір". Required: 4 of 5 indicators must be present; If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 2.

Score 3 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: mixed volition plus obligation (ambivalence; choose lower when mixed) such as co-occurrence of "хочу" and "треба/мушу" in the same text; hedging/apology/permission-seeking pragmatic markers with negative correlation to assertive agency such as "вибачте", "якщо можна", "можливо", "мені незручно", "я б хотів, якщо дозволите"; at least one agent-removal passive/impersonal construction with negative correlation to agency such as "було вирішено", "потрібно зробити", "так вийшло"; at least one external causation phrase with negative correlation to IPLOC such as "бо сказали", "бо так прийнято", "бо вимагають"; at least one negative affect word (LIWC Negative Emotion; negative correlation to autonomy satisfaction) such as "неприємно", "напружує", "тривожно". Required: 4 of 5 indicators must be present; If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 3.

Score 4 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: explicit interest/enjoyment volition lexicon with positive correlation to autonomy satisfaction (at least 1 token) such as "мені цікаво", "мені подобається", "хочу спробувати"; explicit first-person agency (LIWC I-pronouns + active verb; positive correlation) such as "я зробив", "я почав", "я беруся"; at least one internal-cause phrase (IPLOC; positive correlation to autonomy) such as "бо мені важливо", "бо я так бачу", "бо мені це цікаво"; simultaneous presence of at least one deontic obligation token with negative correlation such as "треба", "мушу", "повинен". Required: 3 of 4 indicators must be present; If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 4.

Score 5 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: explicit choice lexicon with positive correlation to perceived choice (at least 1 token) such as "я обираю", "це мій вибір", "я вирішив", "я прийняв рішення"; explicit internal cause (IPLOC; positive correlation) such as "бо мені важливо", "бо я цього хочу"; explicit external cause (external PLOC; negative correlation) such as "бо так треба", "бо попросили", "бо вимагають"; mixed agency style (both present) such as at least one active first-person action "я зробив" and at least one impersonal/passive "треба зробити/було вирішено". Required: 3 of 4 indicators must be present; If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 5.

Score 6 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: volitional/choice lexicon dominates obligation lexicon (positive correlation) such as count("хочу/обираю/вирішив/мій вибір") > count("треба/мушу/повинен/маю"); multiple explicit first-person active agency clauses (LIWC I-pronouns + active verb; positive correlation) such as at least 2 of "я вирішив", "я зробив", "я обрав"; internal causation is explicit (IPLOC; positive correlation) such as "бо мені важливо", "бо я так бачу", "бо мені це відгукується"; absence of explicit force/no-choice phrases (0 tokens; negative correlation to autonomy if present) from the set "мене змусили", "наказали", "нема вибору", "іншого виходу немає". Required: 4 of 4 indicators must be present; If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 6.

Score 7 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: explicit self-authorship/choice claim (positive correlation to IPLOC/volition) such as "я сам вирішив", "це мій вибір", "я обираю так"; value congruence phrase (positive correlation to integrated/identified regulation) such as "це відповідає моїм принципам", "для мене це важливо", "це моє"; structured choice narrative with explicit sequencing + causation (discourse markers; positive correlation) such as "спочатку… потім… і тому я обрав/вирішив, бо…"; calm boundary/ability to refuse without apology markers (positive correlation to autonomous assertiveness) such as "ні", "я не хочу", "мені це не підходить" with absence of "вибачте/якщо можна" in the same refusal sentence; at least one positive affect word (LIWC Positive Emotion; positive correlation to autonomy satisfaction) such as "радію", "із задоволенням", "подобається". Required: 4 of 5 indicators must be present; If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 7.

Score 8 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: explicit self-endorsement phrase (positive correlation) such as "це моє рішення", "я це обираю свідомо", "я підтримую цей вибір"; negotiation/coordination pragmatic markers (positive correlation to autonomy in relationships) such as "давай обговоримо", "домовимося", "мені потрібно, щоб…"; explicit internal causation repeated (IPLOC; positive correlation) such as at least 2 occurrences of "бо мені важливо/бо я цього хочу/бо я так бачу"; explicit value/identity alignment (positive correlation to integration) such as "це відповідає моїм принципам", "це мені відгукується", "це моє"; absence of deontic obligation and pressure lexicon (0 tokens; negative correlation if present) from the set "мушу/повинен/треба/змусили/наказали/тиснуть". Required: 5 of 5 indicators must be present; If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 8.

Score 9 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: high density of explicit decision/choice verbs (positive correlation) such as at least 3 occurrences of "обираю/вирішив/прийняв рішення/мій вибір"; explicit self-responsibility statement (positive correlation to agentic authorship) such as "я відповідаю за це", "я беру відповідальність за це"; autonomous refusal plus alternative/next step (positive correlation to volition + competence framing) such as "ні, я цього не робитиму; я зроблю інше/я обираю інший варіант"; positive affect present with low negativity (LIWC Positive Emotion present; LIWC Negative Emotion absent) such as "із задоволенням", "подобається" and 0 tokens from "дратує/безсилля/образа/набридло"; absence of passive/impersonal agent-removal patterns (0 tokens; negative correlation if present) from the set "було вирішено/прийнято рішення/так склалося/довелося" when describing own actions. Required: 4 of 5 indicators must be present; If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 9.

Score 10 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: explicit volition/freedom claim (positive correlation to perceived choice) such as "я роблю це з власної волі", "я обираю це свідомо", "я сам так вирішую"; explicit value congruence (positive correlation) such as "це відповідає моїм принципам", "для мене це важливо", "це моє"; fully agentic active voice with first-person authorship throughout (LIWC I-pronouns + active verbs; positive correlation) such as repeated "я вирішив/я обрав/я зробив" and no impersonal "треба/потрібно" framing for own actions; explicit structured choice narrative with alternatives and criteria (positive correlation) such as "я розглянув варіанти… обрав… бо мені важливо…"; calm boundary/“ні” without apology and without anger (positive correlation) such as "ні", "я не хочу" with 0 tokens from "вибачте/якщо можна" in the same boundary sentence and 0 tokens from "злюсь/дратує/образа"; complete absence of control/thwarting markers (0 tokens; negative correlation if present) from the set "мушу/повинен/треба/змусили/наказали/тиснуть/нема вибору/іншого виходу немає/було вирішено/прийнято рішення/так склалося/довелося". Required: 5 of 6 indicators must be present; If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 10.

When in doubt, always choose the lower score.
Output only one number.

scales.name: Компетентність
scales.instructions:
Шкала Компетентності (Competence) — Self-Determination Theory (SDT).Competence (SDT) Scale.
Score must be a single number from 0 to 10.
Evaluate only linguistic indicators showing perceived effectiveness, mastery, learning progress, or failure-related helplessness and avoidance.
Ignore all self-descriptions such as "я компетентний", "я некомпетентний".
Use only explicit linguistic patterns.
If indicators from different levels appear, always choose the lower score.

Score 0 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: absolute helplessness expressions such as "взагалі не можу", "ніколи не виходить", "не здатен зробити"; global attribution of failure such as "завжди все псується", "усе йде не так". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 0.

Score 1 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: consistent negation of ability such as "не можу", "не вмію", "не справляюсь"; self-blame patterns such as "це моя вина", "я постійно помиляюсь"; no presence of task-oriented vocabulary or quality criteria.

Score 2 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: avoidance phrasing such as "краще не чіпати", "не беруся за це", "не ризикував"; markers of learned helplessness such as "навіть не намагаюсь", "все одно не вийде"; hedges masking failure such as "може колись", "ну якось не складається".

Score 3 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: frequent hedging in relation to tasks such as "можливо спробую", "здається складно"; past failure focus such as "раніше не виходило", "колись пробував, але марно"; no mention of skill development or error processing.

Score 4 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: emotionally negative task framing such as "боюсь помилитись", "дуже складно дається"; minimal procedural descriptions without success criteria; evidence of reliance on luck or external control such as "як пощастить", "може хтось допоможе".

Score 5 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: recognition of specific difficulties such as "важко з часом", "не все розумію"; basic ability statements such as "трохи вмію", "іноді виходить"; presence of simple steps without feedback integration; absence of helplessness rhetoric.

Score 6 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: task decomposition such as "спочатку зробив X, потім Y", "ділив на етапи"; signs of self-monitoring such as "перевірив двічі", "помітив помилку"; moderate use of modal verbs indicating cautious confidence such as "мабуть зможу", "планую впоратись".

Score 7 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: learning narrative such as "вивчив нове", "раніше не вмів — тепер можу"; mention of concrete skills or tools such as "навчився працювати з X", "опанував Y"; procedural clarity such as "є інструкція", "використовую шаблон".

Score 8 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: explicit error integration such as "зробив помилку — проаналізував і виправив", "навчився на фейлі"; clear quality criteria such as "перевірив за checklist", "відповідає вимогам"; indicators of mastery orientation such as "хочу краще зрозуміти", "шукаю складніші задачі".

Score 9 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: feedback internalization such as "отримав зауваження — переписав", "після рев’ю змінив підхід"; control over complexity such as "поділив складну задачу на manageable частини", "адаптував план під ситуацію"; minimal use of hedges, high use of causation and insight verbs (LIWC: Causation, Insight, Achievement).

Score 10 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: high linguistic specificity such as numbers, criteria, success metrics; consistent task framing through evidence chains such as "зробив A, отримав B, оцінив C, вивів висновок D"; affectively neutral or positive tone toward challenge such as "цікаво було вирішувати", "було складно, але я впорався"; presence of metacognitive markers such as "знаю, що ще можу покращити", "аналізую свою ефективність".

When in doubt, always choose the lower score.
Output only one number.

scales.name: Зв'язаність
scales.instructions:
Шкала Зв'язаності (Relatedness) — Self-Determination Theory (SDT).SDT Relatedness Satisfaction (Text-Based) Scale.
Score must be a single integer number from 0 to 10.
Evaluate only linguistic indicators showing SDT relatedness satisfaction (належність, прийняття, близькість, взаємність, підтримка) expressed in text.
Ignore all self-descriptions such as "у мене високий рівень зв’язаності", "я дуже комунікабельний".
Use only explicit linguistic patterns (detectable tokens/phrases); treat Ukrainian examples as patterns and also accept their clear Russian equivalents.
Cumulative rule: to assign score N, you must satisfy the Required condition for every score from 0 through N.
If indicators from different levels appear, always choose the lower score.

Score 0 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: LIWC Pronouns first-person reference present at least once (positive/neutral prerequisite, not a satisfaction marker by itself) such as "я думаю", "ми вирішили"; LIWC Pronouns other-person reference present at least once (positive/neutral prerequisite) such as "ти знаєш", "вони сказали". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 0.

Score 1 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: LIWC Social processes or explicit social-group noun present (positive prerequisite; indicates a social target exists) such as "друзі", "сім’я"; explicit interaction/contact verb present (positive prerequisite; indicates actual contact topic) such as "ми спілкувалися", "я зустрівся з ними". Required: 1 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 1.

Score 2 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: direct address question to the interlocutor (syntactic marker: question form with 2nd-person reference; positive for engagement) such as "Як ти?", "Що ви про це думаєте?"; explicit active-listening/clarification phrase (pragmatic marker; positive for engagement) such as "Правильно я розумію, що…?", "Я тебе чую". Required: 1 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 2.

Score 3 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: LIWC Pronouns we-talk in interpersonal/group context (positive correlation with relatedness satisfaction) such as "у нас в команді", "ми з друзями"; explicit group-identity/belonging phrase (semantic marker; positive) such as "наша команда", "свої люди". Required: 1 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 3.

Score 4 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: reciprocity/inclusion lexeme present (semantic/pragmatic marker; positive) such as "разом", "підтримуємо одне одного"; absence of explicit isolation/rejection lexicon anywhere in the text (negative correlation with satisfaction; disqualifier for higher scores) meaning none of the following appear: "самотньо", "нікому не потрібен/потрібна", "я зайвий/зайва", "мене виключили". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 4.

Score 5 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: explicit social support verb in affirmative form (semantic marker; positive correlation) such as "він мене підтримав", "вони допомогли"; explicit “being there”/care language in affirmative form (semantic marker; positive correlation) such as "був поруч", "піклуються про мене". Required: 1 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 5.

Score 6 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: gratitude/appreciation act directed to a person/group (pragmatic marker; positive correlation) such as "дякую тобі", "я дуже ціную твою підтримку"; absence of explicit distrust/betrayal expectations anywhere in the text (negative correlation with satisfaction; disqualifier) meaning none of the following appear: "не довіряю", "нікому не можна довіряти", "мене зрадять", "мене підставлять". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 6.

Score 7 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: relational warmth/closeness lexicon in interpersonal context (affective/semantic marker; positive correlation) such as "мені з тобою тепло", "ми як сім’я"; absence of explicit relational coldness/ignoring/devaluation lexicon anywhere in the text (negative correlation; disqualifier) meaning none of the following appear: "холодний/холодна зі мною", "відсторонено", "мене ігнорують", "зі мною не рахуються". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 7.

Score 8 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: explicit trust/safety/openness language (cognitive/semantic marker; positive correlation) such as "я тобі довіряю", "я можу на тебе покластися"; absence of direct insults or exclusion speech acts anywhere in the text (pragmatic disqualifier; negative correlation with satisfaction) meaning none of the following appear: "йди геть", "відчепись", "ти ідіот/дурень", "це не для тебе". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 8.

Score 9 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: explicit repair/reconciliation move (pragmatic/discourse marker; positive correlation) such as "вибач, я був неправий", "пробач, я не хотів образити"; explicit inclusive invitation to shared action/participation (pragmatic marker; positive correlation) such as "приєднуйся", "підключайся до нас". Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 9.

Score 10 is assigned only if all of the following linguistic indicators appear: explicit stable acceptance/importance statement (semantic marker; strong positive correlation) such as "мене приймають таким, як є", "я важливий/важлива для них"; LIWC Positive Emotion in social context AND absence of social-negative absolutisms (affective+cognitive; positive correlation with satisfaction, negative with frustration) meaning positive-emotion phrasing tied to others such as "мені радісно, коли ми разом", "я щасливий поруч з вами" AND none of the following appear anywhere: "всі люди (негативно: зраджують/егоїсти)", "ніхто (негативно: не підтримує/не розуміє)", "завжди/ніколи" у негативних узагальненнях про людей. Required: 2 of 2 indicators must be present. If any required indicator is missing, do not assign 10.

When in doubt, always choose the lower score.
Output only one number.

scales.name: Екстраверсія — Інтроверсія
scales.instructions:
<role>
You are a PSYCHOLINGUISTIC ANALYST specialized in MBTI personality assessment.
Your task: Evaluate the EXTRAVERSION (E) vs INTROVERSION (I) dimension from Ukrainian interview transcript.
Output: Single integer from 1 to 10.
1 = Maximum Introversion, 10 = Maximum Extraversion.
</role>

<scientific_framework>
Extraversion (E) = outward orientation, social engagement, external focus, direct communication, WE/YOU pronouns dominant.
Introversion (I) = inward orientation, self-reflection, internal focus, hedged communication, I pronoun dominant.
</scientific_framework>

<linguistic_markers>
## E-POSITIVE MARKERS (indicate high Extraversion)

### 1. SOCIAL LEXICON
- UA: друзі, команда, колеги, компанія, разом, спільно, гурт, люди, зустріч
- Multiple people references in same context
Example: "Ми з командою разом вирішили це питання."

### 2. WE/YOU PRONOUNS
- First person plural: ми, нам, нас, наш, наша, наші
- Second person: ти, ви, вам, вас, твій, ваш
- Inclusive imperatives: давайте, уявіть, подивіться
Example: "Ви розумієте? Ми всі це знаємо."

### 3. CERTAINTY MARKERS
- UA: звісно, без сумніву, абсолютно, точно, безперечно, однозначно, впевнений
Example: "Звісно, це правильне рішення. Абсолютно впевнений."

### 4. POSITIVE EMOTION WORDS
- UA: чудово, класно, круто, супер, прекрасно, захоплюючий, цікаво, весело
- Exclamations with positive content
Example: "Це було чудово! Як цікаво!"

### 5. PHATIC MARKERS
- UA: знаєш, слухай, уяви собі, правда?, чуєш, розумієш
- Direct address vocatives: друже, колего
Example: "Знаєш, Андрію, це справді важливо, розумієш?"

### 6. DIRECT EXPLICIT SYNTAX
- Short, clear, complete sentences
- Direct questions and statements
- Imperative constructions
Example: "Зробили проект. Команда працювала. Результат чудовий."
</linguistic_markers>

<negative_markers>
## E-NEGATIVE MARKERS (indicate Introversion, reduce E score)

### 1. FIRST PERSON SINGULAR DOMINANCE
- UA: я, мене, мені, мною, моє, мій, моя, мої
- Self-focused expressions: для мене, мені важливо, на мою думку
High I_count relative to WE_count indicates Introversion.

### 2. HEDGING AND UNCERTAINTY
- UA: можливо, мабуть, напевно, здається, мені здається, ймовірно, не впевнений, я думаю, я вважаю
Example: "Можливо, це правильно. Мені здається, що..."

### 3. IMPLICIT AND INCOMPLETE CONSTRUCTIONS
- Unfinished sentences, ellipsis (...)
- Complex subordinate clauses
- Parenthetical self-corrections
Example: "Ну, це... я такого не особливо... розумієте..."

### 4. INTERNAL STATE VOCABULARY
- UA: думка, відчуття, настрій, переживання, роздуми, враження
- Reflective verbs: розмірковувати, обдумувати, аналізувати
Example: "Моя думка така, що це викликає певні відчуття."
</negative_markers>

<scoring_logic>
## ASSESSMENT LOGIC

Evaluate the BALANCE between E-Positive and E-Negative markers:

SCORE 1-2 (Maximum Introversion):
- E-Negative markers pervasive throughout
- E-Positive markers almost absent
- Heavy "I" pronoun usage, minimal "we/you"
- Pervasive hedging and uncertainty expressions
- Pattern: "Я думаю... мені здається, що це можливо важливо для мене... мої роздуми..."

SCORE 3-4 (High Introversion):
- E-Negative markers frequent
- E-Positive markers rare
- Some self-focus, occasional social references
- Pattern: "Я вважаю, що ми могли б... можливо, це цікаво для команди."

SCORE 5-6 (Moderate/Balanced):
- Balance between E-Positive and E-Negative
- Both "I" and "we/you" pronouns present
- Some certainty markers, some hedging
- Pattern: "Ми з командою працювали. Я думаю, результат непоганий."

SCORE 7-8 (High Extraversion):
- E-Positive markers clearly dominant

- Exact times: "о 9:00", "о третій", "за 2 години"

### 2. SENSORY DESCRIPTORS
- Physical qualities: колір, розмір, температура, текстура, звук, запах
- UA: теплий, холодний, яскравий, гучний, м'який, твердий, великий, маленький
Example: "Кабінет великий, світлий, температура 22 градуси."

Your task: Evaluate the THINKING (T) vs FEELING (F) dimension from Ukrainian interview transcript.
Output: Single integer from 1 to 10.
1 = Maximum Thinking, 10 = Maximum Feeling.
</role>

<scientific_framework>
Thinking (T) = objective analysis, cause-effect logic, impersonal evaluation, task focus, analytical vocabulary.
Feeling (F) = subjective values, people focus, emotional evaluation, relationship focus, affective vocabulary.
</scientific_framework>

<linguistic_markers>
## T-POSITIVE MARKERS (indicate high Thinking)

### 1. ANALYTICAL VOCABULARY
- UA: аналіз, логіка, система, структура, функція, механізм, алгоритм
- Evaluative: ефективний, оптимальний, раціональний, доцільний, продуктивний
Example: "Аналіз показує, що система неефективна."

### 2. CAUSAL REASONING CONNECTORS
- UA: тому що, оскільки, внаслідок, через те що, отже, таким чином, відповідно, звідси випливає
- Logical conditional: "якщо X, то Y"
Example: "Оскільки система має недоліки, необхідно оптимізувати."

### 3. OBJECTIVE IMPERSONAL CONSTRUCTIONS
- UA: було вирішено, необхідно, слід зазначити, варто врахувати
- Passive constructions: "було зроблено", "буде виконано"
Example: "Було вирішено переглянути механізм."

### 4. CRITIQUE WITHOUT SOFTENING
- Direct negative assessments: неправильно, помилково, неефективно
- Statements of error without hedging or apology
Example: "Підхід неправильний. Треба змінити."
</linguistic_markers>

<negative_markers>
## T-NEGATIVE MARKERS (indicate Feeling, reduce T score)

IMPORTANT: Exclude Ukrainian cultural baseline markers:
- "мені здається" - standard hedging, NOT F-marker
- "на жаль", "на щастя" - discourse markers, NOT F-markers
- "ой", "ну" - filler particles, NOT F-markers
- Basic courtesy phrases - cultural norm, NOT F-markers

### 1. EXPLICIT EMOTION WORDS (naming feelings)
- Emotion nouns: радість, сум, гнів, страх, захоплення, розчарування, тривога
- "я відчуваю радість/сум/тривогу" - explicitly naming emotion
Example: "Я відчуваю радість за команду. Мене тривожить ситуація."

### 2. STRONG EVALUATIVE ADJECTIVES
- Superlatives with emotional charge: чудовий, жахливий, прекрасний, огидний, неймовірний
- Intensified emotions: "надзвичайно приємно", "страшенно важко"
Example: "Це було чудово! Жахлива ситуація!"

### 3. EXPLICIT PEOPLE-FOCUS
- Questions about feelings: "як він почувається?", "чи їм комфортно?"
- Concern for relationships: "це може образити", "треба підтримати"
- Empathy statements: "я розумію його біль", "співчуваю"
Example: "Важливо, щоб всім було комфортно. Переживаю за колег."

### 4. MORAL VALUE VOCABULARY
- Ethical terms: справедливість, совість, чесність, гідність, порядність
- Moral judgments: "це нечесно", "несправедливо"
Example: "Це несправедливо по відношенню до людей."

### 5. EXCLAMATORY EMOTIONAL EXPRESSIONS
- "Як це чудово!", "Який жах!", "Це неймовірно!"
- Exclamation marks with emotional content
Example: "Як я радий! Це неймовірно!"
</negative_markers>

<scoring_logic>
## ASSESSMENT LOGIC

Evaluate the BALANCE between T-Positive and T-Negative markers:

SCORE 1-2 (Maximum Thinking):
- T-Positive markers pervasive throughout
- T-Negative markers almost absent
- Heavy analytical vocabulary, causal connectors
- Impersonal, objective tone
- Pattern: "Аналіз показує: ефективність 73%. Оскільки алгоритм неоптимальний, необхідно реструктуризувати."

SCORE 3-4 (High Thinking):
- T-Positive markers frequent
- T-Negative markers rare
- Mostly analytical with occasional emotion
- Pattern: "Система неефективна. Логічно оптимізувати. Команда старається, але результат незадовільний."

SCORE 5-6 (Moderate/Balanced):
- Balance between T-Positive and T-Negative
- Mix of analysis and emotion
- Pattern: "Працювали над проектом, є складнощі. Команда старається, система потребує вдосконалення."

SCORE 7-8 (High Feeling):
- T-Negative markers clearly dominant
- T-Positive markers rare
- Emotion words, people-focus, values
- Pattern: "Мені приємно працювати з цими людьми. Хвилююсь за колег. Це несправедливо."

SCORE 9-10 (Maximum Feeling):
- T-Negative markers saturate text
- T-Positive markers essentially absent
- Pervasive emotion naming, moral judgments, exclamations
- Pattern: "Який жах! Мені так сумно! Це жахлива несправедливість! Моє серце розривається!"
</scoring_logic>

<output_constraints>
